mails.subject: Badge désactivé, impossible d'entrer ce matin
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Je suis membre à Kornmarken Studio depuis mars (bureau 22, Aubrac Traduction) et ce matin mon badge ne fonctionne plus. Le lecteur de la porte principale clignote en rouge et la porte reste fermée. J'ai essayé trois fois, puis j'ai attendu qu'un autre membre entre pour le suivre, mais personne n'est arrivé. Je suis donc toujours dehors.

Je dois rendre une traduction juridique de quarante pages à 14 h et tout mon matériel, ainsi que mes dictionnaires, se trouve à l'intérieur. Je n'ai aucun moyen de travailler ailleurs sans mon poste fixe.

Il y a deux jours, j'ai reçu un message qui me demandait de « confirmer mon badge » en cliquant sur un lien. Je ne l'ai pas fait, car l'adresse m'a paru douteuse, mais je me demande si ce message a un rapport avec ce qui se passe. Si quelqu'un a pu récupérer mes identifiants, il vaudrait mieux désactiver mon badge et m'en donner un autre.

Pouvez-vous m'ouvrir la porte ou envoyer quelqu'un ? Mon numéro est le +45 5550 0166, je reste devant l'entrée.

Je précise que ma cotisation est à jour, j'ai réglé la facture d'août le 2 septembre. Je comprends que vous receviez beaucoup de mails, mais c'est vraiment urgent pour aujourd'hui.

Merci d'avance de votre aide rapide,
Delphine Aubrac
mails.justification: A member locked out with a deadline today and a possible credential-phishing incident needs an immediate human response; the suspicious link she mentions is a risk she reports, not a solicitation.

mails.subject: Invoice 2026-0412, wrong amount and VAT
mails.body:
Hi,

Apologies for the late hour, I am catching up on admin on a Saturday night. I have two questions about invoice 2026-0412 for my October desk.

First, the amount. My plan is DKK 1,800 per month excluding VAT, so the total should be DKK 2,250 with 25% VAT, but the invoice says DKK 2,625. I think the day passes I used on 6 and 7 October (2 x DKK 195) were added, although they were included in a bundle I bought in September. Could you check this and send a corrected invoice?

Second, the VAT number. Our company's number is DK 18 62 90 34, and it is missing from the invoice header. Our accountant will not accept it without it. Please add it to this invoice and to all future ones.

Third, and this one is more urgent: my card payment failed this afternoon with an error, and I now see an email from the payment provider saying I have 48 hours to update the details or my access will be paused. I did not click anything in that email since I want to be sure it is real. Can you confirm it is from you, and tell me how to pay safely, perhaps by bank transfer?

I would like to have this resolved before Monday evening, because I have a client coming to the space on Tuesday.

If it is easier to phone, I am at +45 5550 0123 after 09:00.

Thanks,
Gustav Mørk
Mørk & Sønner
mails.justification: A member asks about a wrong invoice amount, a missing VAT number and a failed card, with a payment-warning email he wants verified; it needs a reply within about a day and he is an existing customer.

mails.subject: Kornmarken Kalender: efterårets program og nyt fra køkkenet
mails.body:
Hej,

Her er månedens nyhedsbrev fra Kornmarken Studio. Du modtager det, fordi du tilmeldte dig vores liste, da du besøgte huset.

I oktober sker der en hel masse. Den 8. holder vi Tirsdagsfrokost med temaet "Fra idé til faktura", og den 22. kommer der en gæst fra et lille forlag, som fortæller om at udgive sin egen bog. Tilmelding sker på hjemmesiden, og pladserne er begrænsede, så vent ikke for længe.

Vi har også nye åbningstider i weekenden: lørdag er der åbent kl. 9 til 15 for alle medlemmer med weekendkort. Prisen for weekendkort er fortsat 250 kr. om måneden.

Køkkenet har fået nyt opvaskemaskineprogram, og vi beder alle om at skylle tallerkener af og stille dem i maskinen. Det lyder småt, men det gør en stor forskel for dem, der rydder op sidst.

Tak, fordi du er en del af huset.

Kornmarken Studio
Afmeld nyhedsbrevet via linket på vores hjemmeside.

mails.subject: Fwd: Found a ring? Also a weird question
mails.body:
This isn't a billing or booking thing so I don't know who should answer. Can you take it?

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Lars Thorvald <lars.thorvald@thorvald-law.example>
Date: 18 Oct 2026

Dear Kornmarken Studio,

I am writing about two unrelated matters, so I apologise for the length.

First, my wife attended a ceramics evening in your large room on 8 October and believes she lost her wedding ring there. It is a thin gold band with a small engraving on the inside, "E & L 2014". She remembers taking it off at the sink in the kitchen while washing clay from her hands. We have looked everywhere at home. Would it be possible for someone to check the kitchen drain trap, the lost property box and any place where the cleaners might have put it? We would of course be glad to pay for any plumbing work if the ring is found.

Second, and this is quite different: I am a lawyer, and one of my clients, a small association, is looking for a place to store a few archive boxes for about a year. They would pay a reasonable fee. I know you are a coworking space and not a storage company, but I wonder whether you have any cupboard or basement room that you rent out, or whether you could point us towards someone who does.

To be clear, neither of these is urgent, but the ring matters a great deal to us. I can be reached at this address or on +45 5550 0112 during the day.

Many thanks for your help and kind regards,
Lars Thorvald
Thorvald Law
mails.justification: A forwarded visitor message about a lost ring and a storage question fits no standard category, includes an unrelated offer to pay, and needs a personal reply within the week.

mails.from: Service Vie Associative, Fédération des Coworkings du Nord <secretariat@fcn-reseau.example>
mails.subject: Résiliation de l'adhésion au nom de l'Association Marée Haute
mails.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

Par la présente, l'Association Marée Haute, membre de votre espace depuis janvier 2025, vous notifie sa décision de résilier son abonnement à compter du 30 novembre 2026, conformément à l'article 7 de votre règlement intérieur. Nous vous remercions de bien vouloir nous confirmer cette date par écrit et de nous indiquer les modalités de restitution des clés.

Par ailleurs, notre association souhaiterait organiser un meeting-débat en novembre dans une de vos salles, pour une trentaine de personnes. Si cette proposition vous intéresse, merci de nous faire connaître vos conditions tarifaires.

Veuillez agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l'expression de nos salutations distinguées.

Le secrétariat
mails.justification: A member association formally gives notice and also floats hosting a debate in November; the formal federation letterhead looks like a mass mailing but it concerns a real membership and asks for confirmation.
